site.title: Everyday AI, Done Right
site.tagline: Real AI leverage. Actually free. No credit card.
site.audience: Anyone, anywhere, seeking practical 100% free AI workflows — no paid API keys, no credit card, no subscription tier
site.description: A verified directory of the highest-leverage, highest-value, highest-agency things an ordinary person can do with AI tools that are genuinely, currently free — checked against real provider docs, not vibes.

articles.title: Prompt Injection Detector
articles.hook: Stop LLM hijacks. Drop a system prompt and watch injection vectors cluster.
articles.how_free: Browser Native JS - $0 forever, no external APIs needed

articles.title: Turn a 40-Page PDF Into Plain-Language Answers
articles.hook: Upload a dense 40-page form to Google AI Studio's free chat interface and get page-referenced, plain-language answers without paying $20/month for premium AI.
articles.tool: Google AI Studio (Gemini 1.5 Flash, free tier)

articles.title: Critique Your Resume Against a Real Job Description
articles.hook: Upload your resume PDF and a job description to Claude's free tier, get specific critique of what's wrong with each section, then rewrite the weak parts yourself.

articles.title: Turn Health Screenshots Into Pattern Reports
articles.hook: Upload a week's health app screenshots to Google Gemini 2.0 Flash on AI Studio and get back a structured day-by-day table with cross-metric pattern observations — free, no credit card.
articles.tool: Gemini 2.0 Flash (Google AI Studio, free tier)

articles.title: Turn a Raw Resume Into a Tailored Application
articles.hook: Tailor your resume and draft a precise cover letter for any job description using Google AI Studio's free tier, capped at 1,500 requests per day with no credit card required.
articles.tool: Google AI Studio (Gemini Flash model tier, free tier)

articles.title: Turn Textbooks and Lectures Into a Custom Study Podcast
articles.hook: Upload up to 50 PDFs, web pages, or YouTube links to NotebookLM and generate a two-host AI podcast that debates your specific sources—completely free, but capped at three audio generations per day on a rolling 24-hour clock.

articles.title: Transcribe Audio Files for Free, No Card Needed
articles.hook: Turn any audio recording into text using Groq's free Whisper AI playground—no credit card, no subscription, up to 14,400 files a day. Free forever, no card.

articles.title: Turn a Food Photo Into a Nutrition Label
articles.hook: Take a photo of any meal with ChatGPT's free tier and get an approximate nutrition breakdown — no credit card, no subscription, free forever.

articles.title: Audit Invoices for Hidden Fees
articles.hook: Turn a dense, multi-page contractor invoice or medical EOB into a clean spreadsheet to spot double-billing using Mistral Le Chat's free tier.
articles.tool: Mistral Le Chat (Mistral AI, free tier)

articles.title: Decode Legal Jargon in Any Document for Free
articles.hook: Paste any confusing lease, contract, or official notice into Microsoft Copilot and get a plain-English summary in seconds—free forever, no card, up to 30 uses a day.

articles.title: Read Physical Labels & Mail Aloud Using Built-In AI
articles.hook: Point and Speak uses your iPhone's Neural Engine to read physical text aloud exactly where you point your finger—completely offline, free forever, and built right into iOS.

articles.title: Transform Work History into ATS-Proof Resume Impact Statements
articles.hook: Convert raw work experience bullets into quantified impact statements using Claude's free tier without paid subscription software.

articles.title: Turn Voice Memos into Structured Daily Nutrition & Wellness Tables
articles.hook: Convert messy daily voice dictations into clean macro and activity tables without paying for subscription tracking apps or surrendering personal data to ad networks.

articles.title: Generate Custom Art Reference Photos for Free
articles.hook: Generate specific reference images for your art—poses, lighting, color palettes—using Ideogram's free tier: 25 prompts a day (about 100 images), no credit card.

articles.title: Bypass the ATS Black Hole: Tailor Your Resume for Free Using Claude
articles.hook: Match your resume to any job description using Claude's free tier without paying for commercial resume optimizers.

articles.title: Turn Trip Confirmations Into One Checked Itinerary
articles.hook: OpenRouter’s Free Models Router turns redacted booking details into a source-tagged timeline for $0, with a 50-request daily cap and no card required.

articles.title: Turn a Business Idea Into a Landing Page
articles.hook: Take a one-paragraph description of your business and get a complete, mobile-ready landing page back — free, no card, no expiration.

articles.title: Decode Aggressive Debt Collection Notices
articles.hook: Decode aggressive debt collection letters by cross-referencing them with CFPB data using DeepSeek to spot FDCPA violations.

articles.title: Turn Receipt Photos Into Spreadsheet Data for Free
articles.hook: Snap a photo of a crumpled receipt and get a formatted table of items and prices using ChatGPT's free vision tier—no card needed, no app to install.

articles.title: Turn Messy Receipt Photos Into Clean Expense Spreadsheets Using Mistral Le Chat
articles.hook: Extract line items and totals from receipt photos into spreadsheet tables using Mistral Le Chat without paying for commercial expense apps.
articles.tool: Mistral Le Chat (Mistral AI, free tier)

articles.title: Turn Dense Academic Textbooks Into Structured Study Guides Free Using Groq Cloud
articles.hook: Transform complex textbook chapters into structured study guides and Socratic review questions using Groq Cloud's free tier.

articles.title: Turn Any Textbook Into a Strict Socratic Tutor
articles.hook: Mistral's Vibe gives you 25 high-quality messages per day for free, with no credit card required, and its PDF upload turns any open-source textbook into an interactive tutor that forces you to do the thinking.
articles.tool: Vibe (formerly Le Chat) by Mistral AI

articles.title: Practice Interview Answers Out Loud for Free
articles.hook: Roleplay a job interview using your voice and get instant feedback on your answers with Google Gemini—free forever, no card, no scheduling.
articles.tool: Gemini Pro / Flash (Google Gemini Free Tier)

articles.title: Audit Your Medical Bills and Fight Junk Fees
articles.hook: DeepSeek's web chat is completely free, requires no credit card, and its massive document parser can cross-reference your hospital bill against your insurance Explanation of Benefits (EOB) to find hidden billing errors that cost you thousands.

articles.title: Build Custom Web Tools Without Coding for Free
articles.hook: Describe a custom calculator or tracker in plain English and get a working web app you can use instantly using Claude's Artifacts—free forever, no card, no coding.

articles.title: Audit Entire Multi-File Codebases and Generate Architecture Migrations Free Using Google AI Studio
articles.hook: Ingest whole multi-file repositories into Gemini 1.5 Pro's 2-million-token free window to execute end-to-end architecture audits.
